title: Connecting the Dots · Research Release RR3 · String Confirmation 2026
description: Third citable scientific dataset release of Connecting the Dots, based on the 17 November 2026 ICANN String Confirmation snapshot. It preserves 152 replacement selections and nine withdrawals in the frozen public evidence, and compares 226 published contention sets covering 705 applications with 263 sets covering 891 applications at Reveal Day. ICANN’s announcement and the public APS evidence differ by four in the proceeding-application aggregate after accounting for the separately documented administrative-check case; the discrepancy remains unresolved and does not establish four missing records. Later APS observations are dated and reported separately. The archive preserves reproducible evidence, provenance, and the RR3 scientific addendum. The working paper remains a living draft.
